title: Verify: BootScene single sceneObjects field and unchanged sync unit tests
summary: Unit tests fail while a duplicate sceneObjects field exists and sync still works
description: Add a vitest unit test counting sceneObjects declarations in BootScene.ts, and re-run the existing sync tests to prove behavior is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Given the duplicate field is present, when the test runs, then it fails.
Given ACT2 is applied, when the test runs, then it passes and bootSceneSync tests still pass.
technical_constraints: Reads the source file only; no app, server or browser started
definition_of_done: Test added and passing after ACT2; sync tests green

steps.action: Create the test file. Read ../src/phaser/BootScene.ts with readFileSync (node:fs, utf8). Test 'declares sceneObjects exactly once': count matches of /^\s*private sceneObjects:/gm and expect length toBe(1).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneSingleField.test.ts
steps.expected: Test passes after ACT2; fails with length 2 if the duplicate field is restored.

steps.action: Run the existing bootSceneSync suite unchanged to confirm sync and objectClick forwarding still pass after the field removal.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneSync.test.ts
